name: dory
description: Second brain for Claude Code: writes every session as linked notes into an Obsidian vault and brings active notes back into new sessions.

vault_path.title: Vault path
vault_path.description: Folder of the Obsidian vault dory writes into.

note_language.title: Note language
note_language.description: Language of the note content. Folders, templates and headings stay English.

active_days.title: Active window (days)
active_days.description: Notes touched within this many days are part of the short-term memory.

writer_model.title: Writer model
writer_model.description: Model of the background run that writes the notes.

min_user_messages.title: Minimum user messages
min_user_messages.description: Sessions with fewer of your messages get no note.

auto_capture.title: Write sessions automatically
auto_capture.description: Background run after each session. /dory:save and /dory:note always work.

exclude_paths.title: Excluded folders
exclude_paths.description: Working folders that are never written to the vault automatically.
